writing.title: How a Product Is Made
writing.prompt_cn: 用被动语态介绍一种你熟悉的传统工艺品或产品(如风筝、剪纸、茶、瓷器等)是怎样制作的。写清原料、制作步骤、产地或特色。60词左右。
key_points: 这个产品由什么材料制成(be made of/from)
在哪里制造或出产(be made/produced in)
制作的主要步骤(被动语态:is/are + 过去分词)
它有什么特色或为什么受欢迎
writing.sample: Let me tell you how a kite is made. A Chinese kite is made of paper and thin bamboo. Most kites are made by hand by local people. First, the bamboo is cut and joined into a light frame. Then paper is put on the frame. After that, the kite is painted in bright and lively colors. Finally, a long string is added. Weifang is known for its beautiful kites. A good kite is made with great care, so it can fly high in the sky.
scoring: 内容完整:含材料/产地/步骤/特色四要点(4分)
被动语态:正确使用 is/are/was/were + 过去分词(3分)
语句通顺、衔接词得当 First/Then/Finally(2分)
